content.value: Define rank matrix. Reduce a matrix, $\mathsf { A } = \left[ \begin{array} { c c c c } { 1 } & { 2 } & { - 2 } & { 3 } \\ { 2 } & { 5 } & { - 4 } & { 6 } \\ { - 1 } & { - 3 } & { 2 } & { - 2 } \\ { 2 } & { 4 } & { - 1 } & { 6 } \end{array} \right]$ into echelon form and find its rank.
